verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair axis for an API-driven KYC/KYB compliance platform like AiPrise. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox, test mode, test API keys, or isolation from production data. The cited items cover hosted flows, SDKs, APIs, screening and monitoring, which are adjacent features and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
